# openmediavault: References

Always prefer current openmediavault documentation for exact behavior. Re-verify links and contents when
updating this skill; record the date checked.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor (authoritative)

- Releases and end-of-life dates: https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/releases.html
- Installation (default Workbench credentials, root SSH default, LXC unsupported):
  https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/installation/index.html
- Installing on Debian: https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/installation/on_debian.html
- FAQ (config database, `omv-salt`, managed services, `omv-firstaid`, default shared-folder mode):
  https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/faq.html
- APT and updates (`omv-upgrade`, `omv-release-upgrade`, automatic update checks, repository guidance):
  https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/various/apt.html
- Workbench settings (port, HTTPS, session timeout):
  https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/administration/general/workbench.html
- Network, firewall, and service discovery (Zeroconf):
  https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/administration/general/network.html
- Users and groups: https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/administration/users.html
- SSH service: https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/administration/services/ssh.html
- SMB/CIFS service: https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/administration/services/samba.html
- NFS service: https://docs.openmediavault.org/en/latest/administration/services/nfs.html
- Security policy and advisories (GitHub; none published on the verification date):
  https://github.com/openmediavault/openmediavault/security

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.
